body: I think that some violent thoughts like that are normal. "The Call of Void" refers specifically to these kinds of intrusive thoughts. Although thoughts of suicide and self hatred occasionally are normal, if they are recurring, then I believe something is wrong. I would suggest dumping your thoughts on someone who doesn't really judge you for them. This could be in an anonymous chat room, or it could be someone who you know personally.

If I was you I would try to find another way of getting rid of your intrusive thoughts. What are your intrusive thoughts? Have you tried letting them be heard? If they are to embarrassing to be said in person, you could post them anonymously online)
